blocks.content: The functions of the Commission are mainly recommendatory in nature and it has no power to punish the violators of human rights.

rows: Inquires into violations listed under Union List and Concurrent List
Inquires into violations listed under State List and Concurrent List
Appointed by the President on committee recommendation
Appointed by the Governor on committee recommendation
Removed only by the President (not the Governor)

items: NHRC cannot inquire into any human rights violation matter if one year has elapsed from the date of occurrence.
The recommendations of NHRC are purely advisory and not binding on the government.
In cases involving members of the armed forces, NHRC can only seek a report from the Central Government and make recommendations.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Inquires into human rights violations either suo motu (on its own initiative) or on a petition presented by a victim.
Visits jails and other detention institutions to study living conditions of inmates and suggest remedial measures.
Reviews constitutional and legal safeguards provided for human rights protection and recommends effective implementation.
Encourages and supports the efforts of non-governmental organizations (NGOs) working in the field of human rights.
Recommends payment of compensation or prosecution against public servants, but lacks direct powers to enforce punishment.
